description: Measure how much of a brief's intent JSON a plan satisfies, without gating. Returns { ok, satisfied, total, score, subscores, violations }, where `score` is satisfied/total in [0,1] (an empty intent scores 1); call it across edits to watch a plan approach the brief. The intent's shape is the `archlang://intent-schema` resource. A malformed intent returns `{ ok:false, intentErrors }` as data, never an exception.

brief.description: A brief's intent JSON (shape: the archlang://intent-schema resource) to measure against.

name: score
title: Score a plan against a brief (intent meter)
